title: अंश ५ · अध्याय १८

items.text:
चिन्तयन्निति गोविन्दमुपागम्य स यादवः ।
अक्रूरोऽस्मीति चरणौ ननाम शिरसा हरेः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
cintayanniti govindamupāgamya sa yādavaḥ |
akrūro'smīti caraṇau nanāma śirasā hareḥ || 1 ||

items.text:
सोऽप्येनं ध्वजवज्राब्ज-कृतचिह्नने पाणिना ।
संस्पृश्याकृष्य च प्रीत्या सुगाढं परिषस्वजे ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
so'pyenaṃ dhvajavajrābja-kṛtacihnane pāṇinā |
saṃspṛśyākṛṣya ca prītyā sugāḍhaṃ pariṣasvaje || 2 ||

items.text:
कृतसंवादनौ तेन यथावदू बल-केशवौ ।
ततः प्रविष्टौ संह्टष्टौ तमादायात्ममन्दिरम् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
kṛtasaṃvādanau tena yathāvadū bala-keśavau |
tataḥ praviṣṭau saṃhṭaṣṭau tamādāyātmamandiram || 3 ||

items.text:
सह ताभ्यां तदाक्रूरः कृतसंवादनादिकः ।
भुक्तभोज्यो यथान्यायमाचचक्षे ततस्तयोः ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
saha tābhyāṃ tadākrūraḥ kṛtasaṃvādanādikaḥ |
bhuktabhojyo yathānyāyamācacakṣe tatastayoḥ || 4 ||

items.text:
यथा निर्भर्तूस्यते तेन कसेनानकदुन्दुभिः ।
यथा च देवकी देवी दानवेन दुरात्मना ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
yathā nirbhartūsyate tena kasenānakadundubhiḥ |
yathā ca devakī devī dānavena durātmanā || 5 ||

items.text:
उग्रसेने यथा कंसः सुदुरात्मा च वर्त्तते।
यं चैवार्थं समुद्दिश्य स ससेन विसर्ज्जितः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
ugrasene yathā kaṃsaḥ sudurātmā ca varttate|
yaṃ caivārthaṃ samuddiśya sa sasena visarjjitaḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
तत् सर्व्वं विस्तराच्छ्रु त्वा भगवान् केशिसूदनः ।
उवाचाखिलमप्येतजूज्ञातं दानपते!मया ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tat sarvvaṃ vistarācchru tvā bhagavān keśisūdanaḥ |
uvācākhilamapyetajūjñātaṃ dānapate!mayā || 7 ||

items.text:
करिष्ये च महाभाग!यदत्रौपयिकं मतम् ।
विचिन्त्यं नान्यथैतत् ते विद्धि कंसं हतं मया ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
kariṣye ca mahābhāga!yadatraupayikaṃ matam |
vicintyaṃ nānyathaitat te viddhi kaṃsaṃ hataṃ mayā || 8 ||

items.text:
अहं रामश्व मथुरा श्वो यास्यावः समं त्वया ।
गोपवृद्धाश्व यास्यन्ति आदायोपायनं बहु ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
ahaṃ rāmaśva mathurā śvo yāsyāvaḥ samaṃ tvayā |
gopavṛddhāśva yāsyanti ādāyopāyanaṃ bahu || 9 ||

items.text:
निशेयं नीयतां वीर!न चिन्तां कर्त्तुमर्हसि ।
त्रिरात्राभ्यन्तरे कंसं हनिष्यामि सहानुगम ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
niśeyaṃ nīyatāṃ vīra!na cintāṃ karttumarhasi |
trirātrābhyantare kaṃsaṃ haniṣyāmi sahānugama || 10 ||

items.text:
समादिश्य ततो गोपानक्रु रोऽपि सकेशवः ।
सुष्वाप बलभद्रश्व नन्दगोपगृहे सुखम् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
samādiśya tato gopānakru ro'pi sakeśavaḥ |
suṣvāpa balabhadraśva nandagopagṛhe sukham || 11 ||

items.text:
ततः प्रभाते विमले कृष्ण-रामौ महामती ।
अक्रूरेण समं गन्तुमुद्यतौ मथुरां प्रित ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛṣṇa-rāmau mahāmatī |
akrūreṇa samaṃ gantumudyatau mathurāṃ prita || 12 ||

items.text:
दृष्ट्वा गोपीजनः सास्त्रः श्लथदूवलयबाहुकः ।
निः श्वस्य चातिदुः खार्त्तः प्राह चेदं परस्परम् ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
dṛṣṭvā gopījanaḥ sāstraḥ ślathadūvalayabāhukaḥ |
niḥ śvasya cātiduḥ khārttaḥ prāha cedaṃ parasparam || 13 ||

items.text:
मथुरां प्राप्य गोविन्दः कथं गोकुलमेष्यति ।
नागरस्त्री-कलालापमधु श्रोत्रेण पास्यति ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
mathurāṃ prāpya govindaḥ kathaṃ gokulameṣyati |
nāgarastrī-kalālāpamadhu śrotreṇa pāsyati || 14 ||

items.text:
विलासिवाक्यपानेषु नागरीणां कृतास्पदम् ।
चित्तमस्य कथ भूयो ग्राम्यगोपीषु यास्यति ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
vilāsivākyapāneṣu nāgarīṇāṃ kṛtāspadam |
cittamasya katha bhūyo grāmyagopīṣu yāsyati || 15 ||

items.text:
सारं समस्तगोष्ठस्य विधिना हरता हरिम् ।
प्रह्टतं गोपयोषितूसु निर्गुणेन दुरात्मना ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
sāraṃ samastagoṣṭhasya vidhinā haratā harim |
prahṭataṃ gopayoṣitūsu nirguṇena durātmanā || 16 ||

items.text:
भावगर्भस्मितं वाक्यं विलासललिता गतिः ।
नागरीणामतीवैतत् कटाक्षैक्षितमेव च ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
bhāvagarbhasmitaṃ vākyaṃ vilāsalalitā gatiḥ |
nāgarīṇāmatīvaitat kaṭākṣaikṣitameva ca || 17 ||

items.text:
ग्राम्यो हरिरयं तासां विलासनिगड़ैर्युतः ।
भवतीनां पुनः पाश्व कया युत्तया समेष्यति ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
grāmyo harirayaṃ tāsāṃ vilāsanigaṛairyutaḥ |
bhavatīnāṃ punaḥ pāśva kayā yuttayā sameṣyati || 18 ||

items.text:
एषैष रथमारुह्य मथुरां याति केशवः ।
क्रूरेणाक्रू रकेणात्र निराशेन प्रतारितः ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
eṣaiṣa rathamāruhya mathurāṃ yāti keśavaḥ |
krūreṇākrū rakeṇātra nirāśena pratāritaḥ || 19 ||

items.text:
किं न वेत्ति नृशंसोऽत्र अनुरागपरं जनम् ।
येनेममक्ष्णोराह्लादं नयत्यन्यत्र नो हरिम् ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
kiṃ na vetti nṛśaṃso'tra anurāgaparaṃ janam |
yenemamakṣṇorāhlādaṃ nayatyanyatra no harim || 20 ||

items.text:
एश रामेण सहितः प्रयात्यत्यन्तनिर्घृणः ।
रथमारुह्य गोविन्दस्त्वर्य्यतामस्य वारणो ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
eśa rāmeṇa sahitaḥ prayātyatyantanirghṛṇaḥ |
rathamāruhya govindastvaryyatāmasya vāraṇo || 21 ||

items.text:
गुरूणामग्रतो वक्तुं किं ब्रवपीषि न नः क्षमम् ।
गुरवः किं करिष्यन्ति दग्धानां विरहाग्रिना ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
gurūṇāmagrato vaktuṃ kiṃ bravapīṣi na naḥ kṣamam |
guravaḥ kiṃ kariṣyanti dagdhānāṃ virahāgrinā || 22 ||

items.text:
नन्दगोपमुखा गोपा गन्तुमेते समुद्यताः ।
नोद्यमं कुरुते कश्विदू गोविन्दविनिवर्त्तने ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
nandagopamukhā gopā gantumete samudyatāḥ |
nodyamaṃ kurute kaśvidū govindavinivarttane || 23 ||

items.text:
सुप्रभाताद्य रजनी मथुरावासियोषिताम् ।
पास्यन्त्यच्युतवक्ताब्जां यासां नेत्रालिपङूक्तयः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
suprabhātādya rajanī mathurāvāsiyoṣitām |
pāsyantyacyutavaktābjāṃ yāsāṃ netrālipaṅūktayaḥ || 24 ||

items.text:
धन्यास्ते पथि ये कृष्णामितो यान्त्यनिवारिताः ।
उदूहिष्यन्ति पश्यन्तः स्वदेहं पुलकाञ्चितम् ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
dhanyāste pathi ye kṛṣṇāmito yāntyanivāritāḥ |
udūhiṣyanti paśyantaḥ svadehaṃ pulakāñcitam || 25 ||

items.text:
मथुरानगरीपौरनयनानां महोतूसवः ।
गोविन्दावयवैर्दृष्टरतीवाद्य भविष्यति ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
mathurānagarīpauranayanānāṃ mahotūsavaḥ |
govindāvayavairdṛṣṭaratīvādya bhaviṣyati || 26 ||

items.text:
को नु स्वप्रः सुभाग्याभिर्दृष्टस्ताभिरधोक्षजम् ।
विस्तारिकान्तिनयना या द्रक्ष्यन्त्यनिवारितम् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
ko nu svapraḥ subhāgyābhirdṛṣṭastābhiradhokṣajam |
vistārikāntinayanā yā drakṣyantyanivāritam || 27 ||

items.text:
अहो गोपीजनस्यास्य दर्शयित्वा महानिधिम् ।
उद्धृतान्यत्र नेत्राणि विधात्राकरुणात्मना ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
aho gopījanasyāsya darśayitvā mahānidhim |
uddhṛtānyatra netrāṇi vidhātrākaruṇātmanā || 28 ||

items.text:
अनुरागेण शैथिल्यमस्मासु व्रजता हरेः !
शैथिल्यमुपयान्त्याशु करेषु वलयान्यपि ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
anurāgeṇa śaithilyamasmāsu vrajatā hareḥ !
śaithilyamupayāntyāśu kareṣu valayānyapi || 29 ||

items.text:
अक्रूरः क्रूरह्टदयः शीघ्र प्रेरयते हयान् ।
एवमार्त्तासु योषित्सु घृणा कस्य न जायते ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
akrūraḥ krūrahṭadayaḥ śīghra prerayate hayān |
evamārttāsu yoṣitsu ghṛṇā kasya na jāyate || 30 ||

items.text:
हा हा कृष्णरथस्योच्चैश्व क्ररेणुर्निरीक्ष्यताम् ।
दूरीकृतो हरिर्येन सोऽपि रेणुर्न लक्ष्यते ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
hā hā kṛṣṇarathasyoccaiśva krareṇurnirīkṣyatām |
dūrīkṛto hariryena so'pi reṇurna lakṣyate || 31 ||

items.text:
इत्येवमतिहार्द्दन गोपीजननिरीक्षितः ।
तत्याज व्रजभूभागं सह रामेण केशवः ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
ityevamatihārddana gopījananirīkṣitaḥ |
tatyāja vrajabhūbhāgaṃ saha rāmeṇa keśavaḥ || 32 ||

items.text:
गच्छन्तो जविताश्वेन रथेन यमुनातटम् ।
प्राप्ता मध्याह्नसमये रामाक्रू रजनार्द्दनाः ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
gacchanto javitāśvena rathena yamunātaṭam |
prāptā madhyāhnasamaye rāmākrū rajanārddanāḥ || 33 ||

items.text:
अथाह कृष्णमक्रूरो भवद्भयां तावदास्यताम् ।
यावत् करोमि कालिन्द्यामाह्निकार्हणमम्भसि ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
athāha kṛṣṇamakrūro bhavadbhayāṃ tāvadāsyatām |
yāvat karomi kālindyāmāhnikārhaṇamambhasi || 34 ||

items.text:
तथेत्युक्तं ततः स्त्रातः स्वाचान्तः स महामतिः ।
दध्यौ ब्रह्म परं विप्र!प्रविश्य यमुनाजले ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
tathetyuktaṃ tataḥ strātaḥ svācāntaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ |
dadhyau brahma paraṃ vipra!praviśya yamunājale || 35 ||

items.text:
फणासहस्त्रमालाञय बलभद्र ददर्श सः ।
कुन्दमालाङ्गमुन्निद्र-पद्मपत्रारुणोक्षणम् ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
phaṇāsahastramālāñaya balabhadra dadarśa saḥ |
kundamālāṅgamunnidra-padmapatrāruṇokṣaṇam || 36 ||

items.text:
वृतं वासुकिरम्भाद्यैर्महद्भिः पवनाशिभिः ।
संस्तूयमानं गन्धर्वैर्वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
vṛtaṃ vāsukirambhādyairmahadbhiḥ pavanāśibhiḥ |
saṃstūyamānaṃ gandharvairvanamālāvibhūṣitam || 37 ||

items.text:
दधानमसिते वस्त्रे चारुपद्मावतंसकम् ।
चारुकुण्डलिनं भान्तमन्तर्जलतले स्थितम् ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
dadhānamasite vastre cārupadmāvataṃsakam |
cārukuṇḍalinaṃ bhāntamantarjalatale sthitam || 38 ||

items.text:
तस्योतूसङ्ग घनश्याममाताम्रायतलोचनम् ।
चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्ग चक्राद्यायुधभूषणम् ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
tasyotūsaṅga ghanaśyāmamātāmrāyatalocanam |
caturbāhumudārāṅga cakrādyāyudhabhūṣaṇam || 39 ||

items.text:
पीते वसानं वसने चित्रमाल्य-विभूषणाम् ।
शक्रचापतड़िन्माला-विचित्रमिव तोयदम् ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
pīte vasānaṃ vasane citramālya-vibhūṣaṇām |
śakracāpataṛinmālā-vicitramiva toyadam || 40 ||

items.text:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसञ्चारुकेयूरमुकुटोज्जवलम् ।
ददर्श कृष्णमक्लिष्ट-पुण्डरीकावतंसकम् ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
śrīvatsavakṣasañcārukeyūramukuṭojjavalam |
dadarśa kṛṣṇamakliṣṭa-puṇḍarīkāvataṃsakam || 41 ||

items.text:
सनन्दनाद्यैर्मुनिभिः सिद्धयोगैरकल्मषैः ।
विचिन्त्यमानं तत्रस्थैर्नासाग्रन्यस्तलोचनैः ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
sanandanādyairmunibhiḥ siddhayogairakalmaṣaiḥ |
vicintyamānaṃ tatrasthairnāsāgranyastalocanaiḥ || 42 ||

items.text:
बल-कृष्णौ तथाक्रूरः प्रत्यभिज्ञाय विस्मितः ।
सोऽचिन्तयदू रथाच्छीघ्रं कथमत्रागताविति ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
bala-kṛṣṇau tathākrūraḥ pratyabhijñāya vismitaḥ |
so'cintayadū rathācchīghraṃ kathamatrāgatāviti || 43 ||

items.text:
विवक्षोः स्तम्भयामास वाचं तस्य जनार्द्दनः ।
ततो निष्कम्य सलिलादू रथमभ्यागतः पुनः ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
vivakṣoḥ stambhayāmāsa vācaṃ tasya janārddanaḥ |
tato niṣkamya salilādū rathamabhyāgataḥ punaḥ || 44 ||

items.text:
ददर्श तत्र चैवोभौ रथस्योपर्य्यधिष्ठितौ ।
राम-कृष्णौ यथापूर्व्वं मनुष्यवपुषान्वितौ ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
dadarśa tatra caivobhau rathasyoparyyadhiṣṭhitau |
rāma-kṛṣṇau yathāpūrvvaṃ manuṣyavapuṣānvitau || 45 ||

items.text:
निमग्रश्व ततस्तोये स ददर्ख तथैव तौ ।
संस्तूयमानौ गन्धर्व्व-मुनि-सिद्ध-महोरगैः ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
nimagraśva tatastoye sa dadarkha tathaiva tau |
saṃstūyamānau gandharvva-muni-siddha-mahoragaiḥ || 46 ||

items.text:
ततो विज्ञातसद्भावः स तु दानपतिस्तथा ।
तुष्टाव सर्व्वविज्ञानमयमच्युतमीश्वरम् ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
tato vijñātasadbhāvaḥ sa tu dānapatistathā |
tuṣṭāva sarvvavijñānamayamacyutamīśvaram || 47 ||

items.text:
सन्मात्ररूपिणेऽचिन्त्यमहिम्ने परमात्मने ।
व्यापिने नैकरूपैकखरूपाय नमो नमः ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
sanmātrarūpiṇe'cintyamahimne paramātmane |
vyāpine naikarūpaikakharūpāya namo namaḥ || 48 ||

items.text:
सत्त्वरूपाय तेऽचिन्त्य! हविर्भूताय ते नमः ।
नमोऽविज्ञातपाराय पराय प्रकृतेः प्रभो ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
sattvarūpāya te'cintya! havirbhūtāya te namaḥ |
namo'vijñātapārāya parāya prakṛteḥ prabho || 49 ||

items.text:
भूतात्मा चेन्द्रियात्मा च प्रधानात्मा तथा भवान् ।
आत्मा च परमात्मा च त्वमेकः पञ्चधा स्थितः ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
bhūtātmā cendriyātmā ca pradhānātmā tathā bhavān |
ātmā ca paramātmā ca tvamekaḥ pañcadhā sthitaḥ || 50 ||

items.text:
प्रसीद सर्व्व सर्व्वात्मन् क्षराक्षरमयेश्वर ।
ब्रह्म-विष्णु-शिव्राद्याभिः कल्पनाभिरुदीरितः ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
prasīda sarvva sarvvātman kṣarākṣaramayeśvara |
brahma-viṣṇu-śivrādyābhiḥ kalpanābhirudīritaḥ || 51 ||

items.text:
अनाख्येयखरूपात्मन्!अनाख्येयप्रयोजन!
अनाख्येयाभिधानं त्वां नतोऽस्मि परमेश्वर ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
anākhyeyakharūpātman!anākhyeyaprayojana!
anākhyeyābhidhānaṃ tvāṃ nato'smi parameśvara || 52 ||

items.text:
न यत्र-नाथ!विद्यन्ते नामजात्यादिकल्पनाः ।
तदू ब्रह्म परमं नित्यमविकारि भवानजः ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
na yatra-nātha!vidyante nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ |
tadū brahma paramaṃ nityamavikāri bhavānajaḥ || 53 ||

items.text:
न कल्पनामृतेऽर्थस्य सर्व्वस्याधिगमो यतः ।
ततः कृष्णाच्युतानन्तबिष्णुसंज्ञाभिरीडयसे ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
na kalpanāmṛte'rthasya sarvvasyādhigamo yataḥ |
tataḥ kṛṣṇācyutānantabiṣṇusaṃjñābhirīḍayase || 54 ||

items.text:
सर्व्वार्थस्त्वमज! विकल्पनाभिरेतदू दवाद्य जगदखिलं त्वमेव विश्वम् ।
विश्वात्मंस्त्वमिति विकारभावहीनः सर्व्वस्मिन् न हि भबतोऽस्ति
किञ्चिदन्यत् त्वं ब्रह्मा पशुपतिरर्य्यमा विधाता धाता त्वं त्रिदशपतिः समीरणोऽग्रिः ।
तोयेशो धनपतिरन्तकस्त्वमेको भिन्नार्थैर्जगदपि पासि शक्तिभेदैः ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr:
sarvvārthastvamaja! vikalpanābhiretadū davādya jagadakhilaṃ tvameva viśvam |
viśvātmaṃstvamiti vikārabhāvahīnaḥ sarvvasmin na hi bhabato'sti
kiñcidanyat tvaṃ brahmā paśupatiraryyamā vidhātā dhātā tvaṃ tridaśapatiḥ samīraṇo'griḥ |
toyeśo dhanapatirantakastvameko bhinnārthairjagadapi pāsi śaktibhedaiḥ || 56 ||

items.text:
विश्वं भवान् सृजति सूर्य्यगभस्तिरूपोविश्वञ्च ते गुणमयोऽयमज! प्रपञ्चः ।
रूपं परं सदितिवाचकमक्षरं यजज्ञानात्मने सदसते प्रणातोऽस्मि तस्मै ॥ ५७ ॥
items.tr:
viśvaṃ bhavān sṛjati sūryyagabhastirūpoviśvañca te guṇamayo'yamaja! prapañcaḥ |
rūpaṃ paraṃ saditivācakamakṣaraṃ yajajñānātmane sadasate praṇāto'smi tasmai || 57 ||

items.text:
अँनमो वासुदेवाय नमः सङ्कर्षणाय ते ।
प्रद्यु म्राय नमस्तुभ्यमनिरुद्धाय ते नमः ॥ ५८ ॥
items.tr:
am̐namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya te |
pradyu mrāya namastubhyamaniruddhāya te namaḥ || 58 ||

en_chapter: Parāçara said Thus meditating, Akrura, born in the race of the Yadus, bowed his hand down to the feet of Hari saying—"I am Akrura". And Krishna placed his hand upon him, which was marked with the flag, the thunder-bolt, the lotus, and drew him towards him and affectionately embraced him.

Being thus honored by him, Balarāma and Kesava, delighted, entered with him their own habitation. Having entered into conversation with them and been fed, he related to them everything duly, how their father Anakadundhubi, the princess Devaki and even his own father had been insulted by the wicked demon Kansa and for what purpose he had been despatched. Having heard all from him the illustrious slayer of Kesin said—"O thou of liberal gift, I know all thou hast said; O great one, I shall devise proper measures for this—do not think otherwise of this; consider Kansa as already slain. Rāma and I will go to Mathura tomorrow along with you. The elders of the cow-herds shall accompany us carrying sufficient offerings. Rest here tonight and drive all thy anxiety. Within three nights I will destroy Kansa and all his followers".

Having thus commanded the cow-herds, Akrura with Kesava and Rāma retired to rest and slept soundly in the house of Nanda. The next morning was clear and the young men prepared to proceed to Mathura with Akrura. The females of the cow-herds, on seeing them about to depart, were much afflicted. They wept bitterly—their bracelets were loose upon their arms—and they thus thought within themselves—"If Govinda goes to Mathura, how will he come back to Gokula? His ears will be pleased by the sweet and finished conversation of the damsels of the city. And being used to the language of the graceful females of Mathura he will never again like the rustic expressions of the Gopees. Hari, the pride of our village is taken away and a fatal blow is laid upon us by inexorable destiny.

"The women of the city have sweet smiles, graceful language, beautiful air, elegant gait and significant glances. Hari is of rustic breeding, and, captivated by their fascinations, what likelihood is there of his returning to the society of any one amongst us? Kevasa, who has mounted the car to go to Mathura, has been deceived by the cruel, vile, and desperate Akrura. Does not the unfeeling traitor know the affection that we all here feel for our Hari, the joy of our eyes, that he is taking him away? Unkind that he is, Govinda is departing from us, along with Rāma: haste! let us stop him! Why talk of telling our seniors that we cannot bear his loss? What can they do for us, we are consumed by the fires of separation? The Gopas, with Nanda at their head, are themselves preparing to depart; no one makes any attempt to detain Govinda. Bright is the morning that succeeds to this night for the women of Mathura, for the bees of their eyes will feed upon the lotus face of Achyuta. Happy are they who may go hence without impediment, and behold, enraptured, Krishna on his journey. A great festival will delight today the eyes of the inhabitants of Mathura when they will behold the person of Govinda. What pleasurable dream was seen by the happy damsels of the city that their graceful eyes shall behold unobstructed the countenance of Krishna! Alas! the eyes of the females of cow-herds have been deprived of their vision by the relentless Brahmā, after he had shown them this great treasure. Hari departing with his love for us decayed, the bracelets from our arms slip. The cruel-hearted Akrura urges on the steeds; who does not feel pity for females like us who are bewailing? Alas! behold the dust of Krishna's chariot-wheels! and now he is distanced from us by that for even that dust is no longer to be seen". Thus lamented by the damsels, Kesava and Rāma left the hamlet of Vraja. Travelling in a car drawn by quick-coursing steeds they reached, at noon, the banks of the Yamuna when Akrura requested them to halt a little whilst he performed the usual daily ceremonial in the river. They having agreed to this, the high-minded Akrura bathed in the water and rinsed his mouth and then entering the stream he stood meditating upon the Supreme Being. He beheld, in his meditation, Balabhadra, having a thousand-hooded heads, a garland of jasmine flowers, having large-red eyes resembling lotus petals, surrounded by Vasuki, Rambba and other mighty serpents, praised by Gandharvas, decorated with garlands of wild flowers, clad in dark-coloured raiment, crowned with a chaplet of lotuses, adorned with brilliant ear-rings, drunk and standing at the bottom of the river in the water. He saw on his lap Vishnu, having four arms, and holding conch, discus, and mace, having the complexion of cloud, coppery and expansive eyes, excellent ear-rings and an elegant form, clad in yellow clothes, adorned with many coloured flowers and appearing like a cloud adorned with streams of lightnings and the bow of Indra; his breast was marked with celestial sign, four arms were adorned with keyuras and head with a brilliant crown: he was attended by Sanandana and other holy sages, who, fixing their eyes upon the tips of their noses, were absorbed in profound meditation.

Understanding them as Krishna and Balarāma, Akrura was struck with amazement; and he thought how they could so quickly have got there from the chariot. He desired to ask them of this, but Janarddana deprived him of the faculty of speech at that moment. Having come out of the waters he then came to the chariot and saw there, like before, Rāma and Krishna stationed in their human forms. And having entered the stream again he saw those two forms praised by Gandharvas, great ascetics, Siddhas and great serpents. Apprehending then their real nature he eulogized the eternal deity gifted with discriminative knowledge.

Akrura said:—"Salutation to thee, who art uniform and manifold, all pervading, Supreme spirit, of inconceivable glory and who art simple existence. Salutation to thee, O inscrutable, who art truth and the essence of oblations. Salutation to thee, O Lord, whose nature is unknown, who art beyond primeval matter, who existest in five forms, identical with the elements, with the faculties, with matter, with the living soul and with the Supreme spirit. Be propitiated with me, O soul of the universe, essence of all things, perishable or eternal, whether addressed by the name Brahmā, Vishnu, Siva or like. I adore thee, O God, whose nature is indestructible, whose purposes cannot be deciphered, whose name even is unknown; for the attributes of kind or appellation are not applicable to thee, who art that, the supreme Brahman, eternal, unchangeable, uncreated. But as our objects can not be accomplished but through some specific from, thou art termed by us Krishna, Achyuta, Ananta or Vishnu. Thou, unborn divinity, art all the objects of these impersonation; thou art the gods and all other beings; thou art the whole world, thou art all. Soul of the universe, thou art free from change and there is nothing except thee in all this existence. Thou art Brahmā, Pasupati, Aryaman, Dhātri and Vidhātri! Thou art Indra, air, fire, the regent of the waters, the god of wealth and the judge of the dead; and thou, although but one, presidest over the world with various energies directed to various purposes. Thou, identical with the solar ray, createst the universe: all elementary substance is composed of thy qualities; and thy supreme form is denoted by the imperishable term Sat. I bow to him who is identical with true knowledge and who is and is not perceptible. Salutation to him the lord Vasudeva, to Sankarsana, to Pradyumna and to Aniruddha".
